summary: Tested the review honeypot fix in Preview, both backend and real UI. Backend: test_reviews_testimonials.py passed 34/34 and test_reviews_extra.py 6/6. The new tests/test_reviews_honeypot.py passed 6/6. It covers: suspect=false on a normal review; zx_ctrl or the legacy 'website' field stores the review pending with suspect=true and suspect_reason=honeypot; the WARNING logs for result=stored_pending_suspect and result=refused http=400, with no name, email or text on the line; approved without confirm_suspect returns 400, with it 200; pending→published returns 400; duplicate email+product and identical text return 409; elapsed_ms 1000 returns 400; the 4th POST returns 429. Real UI at 1920: a product review and a brand review show the success card and appear in admin under En attente with no badge. A review with the trap filled by JS shows the success card and appears in En attente and in Suspects with the badge 'Suspect – robot possible'. On Valider, dismissing the confirm keeps it En attente; accepting moves it to À publier. Publier works. Public GET /api/testimonials and the home, product and /donner-mon-avis pages never show suspect, suspect_reason or email. The 409 messages show in review-error. Mocked 500 and 200 without saved:true show an explicit error and no success card. Invitation flow: product locked, email masked (t•••@example.com), token removed from the URL. Admin shows 'Lien après achat' and 'Achat vérifié'. Reusing the link shows the 409 banner; an invalid token shows the error banner. A trap-filled invitation submission is stored as suspect, with log path=invitation. Admin counters stay consistent through each step. Reject (toast 'simulé (Preview)'), Réexaminer, Remettre en attente, Dépublier and delete with SUPPRIMER (button disabled until typed) all work. Tab order: name → email → stars 1-5 → month → year → text → consent → submit; the trap is never focused. There is no input named 'website'. Mobile 390 has no horizontal overflow. ONE BUG FOUND AND FIXED: the trap wrapper used inert="". React 19 treats an empty string as false and logs a console error, so the inert attribute was never rendered. I changed it to the boolean `inert` and confirmed hasAttribute('inert') and .inert are both true.

minor.issue: Dépublier (published→approved) on a suspect review returns 400 unless confirm_suspect=true. The check `inp.status=='approved' and t.suspect` should only apply when the current status is pending or rejected→pending→approved, not when unpublishing. Unpublishing is a protective action and should never need an authenticity confirmation.

ui_bugs.issue: inert="" was rendered as false in React 19, so the attribute was missing and the console showed 'Received an empty string for a boolean attribute inert'. FIXED by the testing agent: changed to `inert`.

integration_issues.flow: Admin Dépublier on a suspect review
integration_issues.issue: Clicking Dépublier on a published suspect review opens the window.confirm 'confirmez-vous qu'il est authentique et autorisé à être publié ?'. Dismissing it leaves the review published. The wording does not match the action, and it adds friction to taking a review down. In Row.setStatus, use confirmSuspect = status==='approved' && t.status==='pending' && t.suspect, and align the backend check with cur=='pending'.

action_items: Restrict the suspect confirmation to validation from pending (backend: `cur == 'pending'`; frontend: `t.status === 'pending'`) so that Dépublier on a suspect review needs no authenticity confirmation.
Keep the `inert` boolean fix in ReviewPage.jsx (do not revert to inert="").
critical_code_review_comments: reviews.py admin_testimonial_status: the suspect check runs for every transition to 'approved', including published→approved (unpublish). It should be limited to pending→approved.

tests/ui_setup_reviews.py hardcodes BASE URL and admin credentials. Its teardown also deletes testimonials by an email regex (^test_ui_.*@example.com$) and every rate_hits doc in the review buckets, not by id. That is acceptable in Preview, but could remove another concurrent run's data.
A suspect review still blocks a legitimate resubmission (409, same email and product) while it is pending. That is acceptable, but the admin should review suspects promptly.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (1 bug fixed, 1 minor UX/logic issue on Dépublier for suspect reviews)

seed_data_creation: None kept. All TEST_ testimonials, the test orders and the invites were deleted (teardown plus pytest cleanup by email). rate_hits were cleared only for the review buckets. 'Ben' was not touched (updated_at 2026-11-25). site_config testimonials is still enabled/show_home/show_products = true.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && /etc/supervisor/emergent-env-exec python3 -m pytest tests/test_reviews_honeypot.py tests/test_reviews_testimonials.py tests/test_reviews_extra.py -n 0, with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. The rate limit is 3 per 10 min, so clear the rate_hits review buckets between UI batches. Admin login is at /admin/login with [data-testid=admin-email-input], [data-testid=admin-password-input] and [data-testid=admin-login-submit], then open [data-testid=admin-tab-trust].
rca of the issue: inert: React 19 supports `inert` as a boolean prop, and an empty string is now coerced to false (React 18 passed the string through). As a result the wrapper was not inert; aria-hidden and tabIndex=-1 still kept the trap out of keyboard focus. Dépublier issue: the backend condition `inp.status=='approved' and t.get('suspect')` does not consider the current status.
